name: Predictive Policing
focus: data-driven forecasting of where and when crime or incidents are likely to occur, hotspot and risk-terrain modelling, and evaluations of how effective and fair these methods are

name: AI Policing
focus: artificial intelligence and machine learning in law enforcement: governance and ethics frameworks, operational use cases, generative AI, and public-sector AI adoption

name: Digital Twin
focus: digital twins and simulation for cities, emergency response, security operations and public safety, including scenario modelling and strategic foresight

name: Autonomous Surveillance
focus: drones, robots, autonomous patrol and AI-enabled video analytics for public safety, with attention to effectiveness, oversight and privacy

name: Smart Investigation
focus: data and AI-driven investigation: digital forensics, e-evidence, evidence analysis, image and video analytics, and cybercrime investigation
